correctness.rationale: Complete exact rational matrices for all three symmetry classes; expected energy equals their largest eigenvalue by independence. Equal-trace determinant comparison eliminates central-last; common-eigenvalue elimination gives exact quintic; transformed coefficients have one sign change and rational signs isolate the only root; upper-eigenvalue inequalities and exact endpoint comparisons select the branches. Direct enumeration of all eight masks and all six orders, symbolic identities, seven rational parameter cases and verifier replay passed. The proof is for all 0<=p<=1.

value.rationale: Independent loss of delivered row actions occurs in distributed/limited-reliability equation solvers. The complete, sharp, three-row equal-budget minimax classification exhibits a reliability-induced reversal despite identical probabilities and costs, giving a precise counterexample to reusing a perfect-delivery order. This is a natural minimal redundant row system with small integer normals, not an arbitrary table lookup or simple textbook substitution; scope is explicit and not claimed general.
